note: The two sets are essentially identical: both capture the two Figure 7-3 regression results (pitch sensitivity at θ=0° and θ_k = 6.302336°) with the same quotes and the same defects. Both truncate the unit as 'watt/ra' in the first claim, both state θ_k as a bare 'θ'/'theta' with a quote that drops the subscript k, and both repeat each fact twice. Set B's fourth claim names the property slightly more precisely (pitch sensitivity (∂P/∂θ) at θ = 0°) than Set A's, but this is a marginal difference and both are correct.
remarks: Both sets misread the unit as 'watt/ra' (page: 'watt/rad') and both mislabel θ_k as plain θ/theta, losing the fact that 6.302336° is the blade-pitch angle at which pitch sensitivity has doubled from its rated value (Eq. 7-17). Both also duplicate each of the two facts under two attribute names. Neither set notes that the regression is for Region 3 / the best-fit line of Figure 7-3.
